svg.title: The Mano River Union
svg.desc: Map of West Africa highlighting the four members of the Mano River Union: Sierra Leone and Liberia, which founded it in 1973, Guinea, which joined in 1980, and Côte d'Ivoire, which joined in 2008. Its secretariat is in Freetown. The Mano River forms part of the border between Sierra Leone and Liberia.
